description: The provenance of a single output column of a defining-SQL object: its derivation kind and the immediate source column(s) it derives from.

outputColumnId.description: The ColumnModel id of the output column this entry describes.

derivationKind.description: How the output column derives from its input(s).

setFunctionType.description: The set function applied, present only when the derivationKind is AGGREGATE. Carries the name of the SQL set function (e.g. COUNT, MAX, SUM), which lets a policy layer distinguish a protected count from other aggregates.

inputs.description: The immediate source column(s) this output column derives from. Empty for a LITERAL. May contain multiple entries for a JOIN, a multi-input expression (e.g. concat), or a UNION (the union of the inputs from every branch).
